# Welcome to the Sunny Side!

> Personal site and blog: algorithms (problems, theory, contests), literature, life and miscellany.

Each page at https://www.welcome-to-the-sunny-side.com/<path>.html has its markdown source at https://www.welcome-to-the-sunny-side.com/<path>.md; math is TeX between $...$ / $$...$$. Prefer the markdown when reading a post.
